title: Arthur-Langlands Reciprocity
exact_target: Establish the general Arthur-Langlands reciprocity correspondence between constituents of the discrete automorphic spectrum of a connected reductive group $G$ and the appropriate global Galois or Arthur parameters, compatibly with localization and automorphic $L$-functions.
